title: Add compact authoring checkpoints and telemetry-guided RAG templates
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: customers asked for smaller, repeatable authoring artifacts that capture stable checkpoints for RAG authoring workflows and enable telemetry-driven regressions during prompt/index changes. This PR adds a compact 'checkpoint' template format, new telemetry-guided assertion examples, and an embedded authoring devcontainer/watch-mode recipe so engineers can iterate locally against seeded indexes. What this includes: 1) new compact checkpoint schema and examples (YAML+JSON) that capture prompt seeds, index snapshot pointers, and golden-response assertions; 2) a telemetry-guided assertions guide that maps telemetry signals (token-latency, rerank-quality, recall-window) to test thresholds and suggested remediation; 3) two new runnable samples: typescript/mini-agent and python/authoring-worker that demonstrate checkpoint-driven test runs and automatic rollback hooks; 4) a minimal devcontainer and a lightweight file-watcher that automatically runs the checkpoint harness on file changes; 5) an authoring VS Code extension manifest (samples only) that surfaces checkpoint failures inline and links to telemetry dashboards. Checklist: - [x] Add checkpoint schema and examples - [x] Add step-by-step guide for telemetry assertions - [x] Add TS and Python samples with README how-to - [x] Add devcontainer + watch-mode recipe - [x] Add tests for the harness smoke flow - [x] Docs lint and build passed How to validate: follow the README in docs/rag-authoring/checkpoints to run the devcontainer, create a checkpoint, and run `python harness.py --checkpoint ./samples/checkpoints/minimal.yaml`. Related work: follows ENG-8945 (authoring stability) and references the RAG telemetry taxonomy doc. Migration notes: existing RAG tutorials are unaffected; checkpoint templates are opt-in. This PR is documentation and samples only; no runtime changes to production serving are included.
commits: 4 commits: (1) add checkpoint schema and examples; (2) telemetry-guided assertions doc + thresholds; (3) add TS/Python sample harness and readmes; (4) devcontainer and watch-mode script; commit messages include small fixes to examples and CI metadata.

merge_outcome: Merged by squash via web UI. Commit message: 'docs: authoring checkpoints + telemetry assertions (ENG-8945)'. Backported: none. No prod runtime changes. Merge blocked briefly by CI linkcheck failure which was corrected in a follow-up commit.
release_notes: Introduce opt-in compact authoring checkpoints for RAG workflows, plus telemetry-guided assertion recipes and local devcontainer/watch-mode for faster iteration. Samples added: python harness and typescript mini-agent. No breaking changes.
notes_for_ops: This change only affects docs and examples; no operational rollout required. Telemetry thresholds in the docs are recommendations and should be tuned against production signals before automation is enabled.
testing_instructions: See examples/rag-harness/python/README.md and examples/rag-harness/ts/README.md. Quick verify: start devcontainer, run ./tools/watchers/checkpoint-watcher.sh on the samples folder, then modify samples/checkpoints/minimal.yaml and observe harness smoke tests passing.
